name: Gabumon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name and 1 Digimon card with [Agumon], [Greymon] or [Omnimon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the rest on top of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon digivolves, gain 1 memory.
